subsystems.name: Reasoning and planning core
subsystems.role: decomposes high-level goals into steps and decides what to do next.

subsystems.name: Memory and context
subsystems.role: stores past interactions, knowledge and current task state so the agent does not forget.

subsystems.name: Tool and action layer
subsystems.role: lets the agent actually do things in software: call APIs, write code, browse the web.

subsystems.name: Orchestration and multi-agent coordination
subsystems.role: runs several specialised agents together and assigns work.

subsystems.name: Safety, oversight and evaluation
subsystems.role: keeps the agent within bounds and catches mistakes.

buildSteps.title: Map the environment
buildSteps.detail: Identify which platforms, APIs and data sources the agents must operate, and what permissions they will need.

buildSteps.title: Assemble training data
buildSteps.detail: Collect demonstrations of human workflows, tool-use traces and successful task completions to teach the model how to act.

buildSteps.title: Train or fine-tune the core model
buildSteps.detail: Start from a large language model, then use instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback to improve planning and tool use.

buildSteps.title: Implement memory and state
buildSteps.detail: Add a vector database for long-term recall, a context manager to fit relevant information into the model's window, and a task log.

buildSteps.title: Build the tool integration layer
buildSteps.detail: Write connectors to each external service, with sandboxed code execution and error handling for failed calls.

buildSteps.title: Develop planning and self-correction loops
buildSteps.detail: Implement recursive reasoning where the agent proposes a plan, executes a step, checks the result, and revises the plan if needed.

buildSteps.title: Add multi-agent orchestration
buildSteps.detail: Create a supervisor that breaks a goal into sub-tasks, assigns them to specialised agents, and merges their outputs.

buildSteps.title: Install safety and oversight
buildSteps.detail: Add policy filters, permission systems, human approval steps for sensitive actions, and full logging.

buildSteps.title: Pilot, monitor and iterate
buildSteps.detail: Deploy in a controlled setting, measure success and failure rates, and continuously retrain on new data while guarding against drift.

prerequisites.tech: Large language models with strong reasoning and instruction following
prerequisites.why: they provide the basic ability to understand goals and generate plans.

prerequisites.tech: Reliable tool use and function calling
prerequisites.why: models can call APIs, but error rates are still high for long sequences of actions.

prerequisites.tech: Long-term memory and long context windows
prerequisites.why: current context windows are large but not unlimited, and retrieving the right memory remains hard.
agents can plan, but they often fail on tasks requiring many steps or recovery from unexpected errors.
frameworks exist, but stable, efficient teamwork between agents is not yet solved.

prerequisites.tech: Safety and alignment for autonomous action
prerequisites.why: keeping agents from harmful or unintended actions is an open research problem.

pathway.milestone: single-purpose agents for coding, customer support and data entry
pathway.unlocks: productivity gains in narrow, well-defined tasks.

pathway.milestone: agents that can complete multi-step workflows within one platform
pathway.unlocks: automation of routine business processes with human oversight.

pathway.milestone: cross-platform generalist agents that plan and execute across several systems
pathway.unlocks: autonomous project management and reduced coordination overhead.

pathway.milestone: self-improving teams of agents managing end-to-end operations
pathway.unlocks: new organisational forms, alongside major governance and safety challenges.
